title: Rams lean on Blake Corum's 184 yards and a strong defense to defeat Packers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams lean on Blake Corum's 184 yards and a strong defense to defeat Packers
sources.description: Blake Corum rushes for a career-high 184 yards and a touchdown on his birthday as the Rams beat the Green Bay Packers 26-13 to extend their win streak.
